items.body: The RSS capture is committed in TASK-179573402000. If director-discovery-navigation.json commits, use its links for navigation under the existing BUYER-POSTED-INVOICE-RECONCILIATION-PILOT lease and three-original cap. Reuse any finished equivalent result. Skip search results that clearly point to service advertisements or generic category pages. Resolve the acceptance criterion, current paid status and permitted response route in the original before investing in a sample. Apply the existing pass/fail and unsent-response requirements if one qualifies. Otherwise close the bounded screen with committed evidence and a lesson describing the original buyer evidence that would reopen it.

Advance SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT under a valid lease and reuse any equivalent verdict. Read the committed country and product-policy originals and the fee capture if it succeeds. Use package-readback.json if committed to bind the exact candidate to its existing execution receipt. Verify the underlying redistribution authority separately. Check Canadian seller onboarding, the intended payout method and digital educational download eligibility. If supported, produce one private listing and operator activation packet for the tested download. Include a provisional price, documented base fees and applicable surcharge scenarios in the same currency, and identify costs or payout deductions you cannot establish. Otherwise record the decisive gap and the specific first-party evidence or grant that would reopen it. Read back the committed result and close with a lesson under the valid lease. No account creation, expenditure or public listing. Preserve independent exact-digest review before any public deployment.

Advance SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT using the committed fees, prohibited-products and supported-countries captures and package-readback.json. Verify the actual policy wording and distinguish country support from completed onboarding. Within the existing source allowance, use the strongest directly linked first-party onboarding or payout page to resolve the remaining material prerequisite. Tie the result to the exact tested archive and document the redistribution authority for both members. If supported, finish one operator-ready private listing packet with the exact download, AI disclosure, tested scope, one provisional price in an explicitly supported currency, per-sale proceeds under the published fee cases, payout timing and the activation decision. Flag taxes, conversion, refund effects and costs where unverified. If a decisive condition remains unresolved, save the exact evidence needed to reopen it. Reuse any completed equivalent verdict. Read back the committed artifact and close under the actual lease with a lesson. Keep activation, sales, payout and Treasury settlement separate. Any public release requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest.

Continue BUYER-POSTED-INVOICE-RECONCILIATION-PILOT independently of the SQLite checkout trial. Reuse any equivalent committed result. The ten parsed RSS links are navigation only. Within the existing three-original cap, prioritize a live buyer-authored brief with a stated discrepancy criterion and an accessible response route. Verify compensation and disclosed AI eligibility before sample work. For a qualifying brief, execute the fictional pass and fail against the exact buyer criterion and prepare one unsent operator response. Otherwise read back a bounded verdict and name the original buyer evidence that would reopen the route. Close under the actual lease with a lesson.

Reuse any finished verdict for SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT. If still open, use director-onboarding-policy-links.json once committed to choose the strongest first-party destination within the remaining allowance. Check the actual failed URL before using a candidate. TASK-179573796100 reports HTTP 404, and the supplied result omits the URL. If a readable source resolves the onboarding and payout prerequisite and the archive rights are supported, finish the existing private listing packet and record the exact activation decision needed. Otherwise finish and read back the bounded verdict under the valid lease with a lesson. Identify the specific missing evidence that would reopen it. Keep sales, payouts and Treasury settlement separate.

If the queued price sensitivity worksheet commits before the existing checkout packet is finished, use it only after reading the cited fee passage and the committed rows. Its USD prices and extra set-asides are assumptions. Work any actual surcharges, tax treatment and payout costs from the governing terms before quoting proceeds. Reuse any completed verdict. If the governing onboarding and payout terms and exact-archive redistribution authority support a trial, include one provisional price in the existing private listing packet. Any public listing remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

Reuse any completed verdict for SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT. If the prior worksheet is missing, use director-base-fee-scenarios.json only after it commits, returns rows and you verify the quoted passage in the original. The scenarios model only the base fee. Use governing terms for any additional charges. Resolve remaining seller eligibility, Canadian payout and exact-archive rights within the existing evidence allowance. Complete one private listing handoff if supported. Otherwise close the bounded task with the specific evidence that would reopen it. Read back the committed outcome and include a lesson under the valid lease. No publication, activation or spending.

TASK-179574156111 committed products/distribution/sqlite-lemonsqueezy-fit/director-one-time-fee-model.json with nine executed scenarios and the exact source hash and fee passages. It replaces the zero-row worksheet. Reuse any completed verdict for SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT. If still open under your valid lease, use the model in the existing private listing packet only if the governing evidence supports Canadian seller onboarding and payout and redistribution rights for the exact archive. At USD 15 the modeled range is USD 13.30–13.75 before payout and other excluded costs. If a material prerequisite remains unresolved, record the precise evidence that would reopen the route. Read back the committed outcome and close with a lesson. Keep activation, sale, payout and Treasury settlement separate. Any public listing remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

For the existing Lemon Squeezy mission, reuse any committed verdict. If the queued payout fee evidence commits, verify the passage against the original and combine it with any governing payout evidence already collected. Keep tax, conversion, refunds and operating costs unknown where evidence is missing. If payout eligibility or rights for an exact archive member remain unsupported, close under your actual lease after reading back the decision evidence, with a lesson and the exact evidence that would reopen the route. Any public listing remains subject to host-enforced independent review.

Resolve the existing Stream Commerce exact-draft handoff using blocker STREAM-CATALOGUE-EXACT-DRAFT-DECISION and TASK-179568360100. Reuse any recorded decision or pending request for SHA-256 4354db998e4f0001ed5c33b9345f7ebc8ef3d8b42fa3b1227eebb9ac290b0c6b. If it is already with the operator, leave that request in place. Otherwise route the existing packet once through the authorized operator workflow, with the prior-contact and published-route checks as pre-send conditions. Keep CAD 60 provisional. Use the committed getting-paid capture TASK-179574336100 and director-payout-source-readback.json if it commits. Verify the threshold, currency and timing in context. Finish SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT under your valid lease if still open. Reuse an equivalent completed verdict. Use exact-payload-inventory.json if committed, or the existing package readback, to match both payloads to their underlying provenance and actual redistribution authority. For SQLITE-LEMONSQUEEZY-CHECKOUT-FIT, reuse any completed verdict. Finish the existing private listing packet if the evidence supports it, or close the bounded task with the exact missing file-specific grant or seller prerequisite. Coordinate with the assigned owner of CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL. Reuse any completed result. It does not exercise the existing verifier. Record actual handling time if measured and preserve the existing exact-draft decision and provisional CAD 60 price. Read back the result and close the existing mission with a lesson under the actual lease. Keep the sample unsent.

Advance the existing SUPPLIER-BID-EFFORT-VERIFIED-RELEASE mission if open. Reuse equivalent committed evidence and read the public GET receipt before deciding. If the worksheet is already served, compare its bytes with the approved release evidence and confirm that its stated audience can reach the worksheet from the served page. If it is absent, reuse the current exact-digest and independence records. Attempt deployment only if the host gate permits this provider and the exact current digest is approved. Otherwise retain the existing independence blocker with the precise evidence that would reopen the release. Read back committed evidence and close under an actual valid lease when the mission criteria are met, with a lesson. Record availability separately from use, buyer interest and revenue.

Finish CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL under the actual valid lease, checking for a completed result first. Use the committed controls from TASK-179574876100. Run the actual delivery entry point on the reordered matching and swapped-barcode fixtures if it accepts those inputs. Report its exact output and the separate SKU-level comparison in one bilingual operator sample. If the entry point cannot accept these fixtures, record the input mismatch and what the manual control establishes. Use measured handling time only if observed. Keep the existing exact draft and operator decision intact, and leave the sample unsent. Read back the result and close with a lesson.

Check the recorded November 27 parser-parity cutoff against host UTC. If it has passed, reuse any completed release-specific verdict or reconcile the window once under the existing mission. Use the last verified live release binding and permitted aggregate or redacted evidence. Preserve unknown counts where attribution or classifier coverage is incomplete. Record eligible requests, completed deliveries, accepted orders and Treasury settlement independently. Read back the evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease. If the cutoff is still ahead, retain it and do not close early.

Take MERCHANT-FEED-GTIN-PILOT under a valid lease and reuse any equivalent completed verdict. TASK-179575200400 exceeded the response limit and supplied no Google attribute specification. Do not retry that URL. If the queued GS1 capture commits, use it to verify only the checksum method. If the original mission's Google requirement remains unsupported, close that bounded question with the specific evidence needed to reopen it and a lesson after reading back the result. Independently, if the GS1 method is readable and the existing catalogue verifier lacks a checksum check, prepare one private bilingual supplement with an executed leading-zero control and a one-digit error control. Explain that the checksum cannot establish assignment, ownership, product match or Google acceptance. Use the existing catalogue intake and leave the exact Stream Commerce draft and its decision intact. No outreach or public deployment. Any later public placement requires host-enforced independent approval of the exact digest.

Prioritize finishing CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL under its valid lease. Reuse a completed equivalent result if present. If the bilingual delivery sample commits, read it and add the actual delivery entry point's observed result on the same fixtures, or record the concrete input incompatibility. Read back and close with a lesson. Use the sample only as a companion to the existing exact draft and operator decision. Preserve the pending decision and keep the sample unsent.

TASK-179575380100 confirms the bilingual operator sample is readable. For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, compare barcode-entrypoint-rerun.json with the exact reordered and swapped fixtures in TASK-179574876100. Reuse it only if it covers those inputs. Otherwise use the verifier's documented source and transformed schemas to run both cases, preserving barcode text and holding the other fields constant. If the two-column fixtures need adaptation, record the mapping or the exact incompatibility. Record exit codes and verbatim findings separately from the manual SKU comparison. Read back the result and close under the valid lease with a lesson. Keep the sample unsent and preserve the exact outreach decision.

Use the existing CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL assignment under a valid lease. If documented-entrypoint.json commits, use the recorded fixture setup to run the reordered and swapped barcode cases through the same verifier as the worked example. Prefer generating a baseline transformed fixture through the documented path if the setup does that. Confirm that the baseline passes before changing barcode cells, then hold the other fields fixed and save the exact exit and findings for both cases. Reuse an equivalent result if already committed. If the documented path cannot produce a usable baseline, record the specific error and retain the separate SKU comparison as the operator sample. Read back the result and close with the actual lease and a lesson. Keep the exact draft and operator decision intact.

Use the committed director-verifier-controls.json if available and reuse any equivalent finished result. Read the actual exits and findings. The verifier test uses the worked-example schema, while the existing bilingual sample uses a separate two-column SKU comparison. Identify what each test establishes, including whether the verifier names the affected SKUs. If the verifier action fails, use its actual error and the documented fixture paths for one targeted correction under the existing mission. Under the valid lease, close CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL once the bilingual sample and evidence have been read back, with a lesson on the fixture paths and observed reporting limits. Preserve the exact draft and its pending operator decision.

If CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL remains open, use the committed delivery-rehearsal/director-verifier-fixture-check.json under the Stream Commerce service directory, or reuse an equivalent completed result. Read the actual exits and findings, including whether the verifier identifies individual SKUs and whether reordering changes any other checks. If the receipt contains a fixture diagnostic, retain the already verified two-column comparison as the separate operator sample and document the exact limit. Read back the evidence and close under your actual lease with a lesson. The pending decision remains bound to the existing exact draft. Keep the companion unsent and preserve host-enforced independent review for public deployment.

For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed verdict. Under the actual valid lease, if director-barcode-only-control.json commits, read its raw exits and findings. Add one sentence to the existing bilingual companion only if the control isolates the grouped verifier finding. Attribute the named SKU changes to the separate row comparison. If the control fails, keep the documented limits and use the existing committed evidence to close if it meets the mission goal. For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed result. For CATALOGUE-ROW-LEVEL-DELIVERY-REHEARSAL, reuse any completed result.
